name: fac-training-session-plan
description: Plans a session that teaches a skill, producing a timed flow in five blocks (open, recall, show, practise, apply), the share of time given to practice, the scripted first five minutes and the energy logic across the day. Use for "run fac-training-session-plan", "session plan", "training session plan", "lesson plan for adults", "how do I open a training session", "there is never time for practice", "turn my topic list into a session", "nine events of instruction", part of the Claude for Trainers and Facilitators Pack by 90n.
